hero_text: Pulita designs, builds and supports the whole chain: refuelling stations, mother stations, L-CNG stations and gas-fired power plants.
intro_title: Daughter stations, mother stations and power plants.
intro_text: Pulita delivers each solution turnkey: design, equipment, construction, commissioning and local service.
daughter_epc_title: Standard CNG daughter station EPC & petrol station conversion
daughter_epc_text: Turnkey CNG daughter stations supporting gas flow rates of 600–7,000 m³/h. We also convert old petrol stations into CNG/LNG refuelling stations, so existing forecourts can start selling gas quickly.
mother_station_title: EPC services for CNG mother stations
mother_station_text: Pipeline-fed CNG mother stations with capacities from 2 to 10 MMSCF/d. Gas is treated, metered and compressed to 250 bar, then loaded into tube trailers that supply daughter stations, MRUs and gas-powered sites.
lcng_text: L-CNG stations store LNG on site and convert it to CNG for dispensing, bringing natural gas to locations far from any pipeline. Station capacities range from 20 to 60 tons.
ipp_text: Independent power plants built from synchronised Pulita gas generator sets and containerized power units, with gas supply, PRMS and switchgear engineered and delivered as one project.
ev_title: EV charging stations, powered your way.
ev_text: Pulita designs and supplies EV charging stations for electric cars and buses. Each station draws on a hybrid mix of solar power, battery storage, gas generator sets and grid electricity, so charging never stops when one source does.
